The following series follows a fixed pattern:
2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 5, 5, 6, …
If the pattern continues, determine how many times the number 9 appears in the NEXT 20 terms.
a) 3
b) 4
c) 7
d) 8
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Turn the series into a rule. Write each number with how many times it appears: 2 once, 3 twice, 4 three times, and so on.
Slicer
break it into small parts
Split the next 20 terms into blocks: the 6s still to come, then all the 7s, then all the 8s. Count each block.
YOUR TURN
How many places are left for 9s?
2
The following number series is based on a pattern. One term is incorrect. Identify the incorrect term.
2, 3, 6, 11, 18, 25, 38, 51, 66, 83
a) 11
b) 25
c) 51
d) 66
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Write the gaps under the series. What pattern do most of the gaps follow?
Roots
ask why it works
Ask which single term, if changed, makes every gap fit. Check the terms after it too.
YOUR TURN
Name the term you would change.
